## Crystal Dragon, Wyrm (CR 16)

**XP** 76,800  
 CG Huge dragon (earth)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** dragon senses, tremorsense 120 ft.; Perception +31; **Aura** frightful presence (330 ft., DC 29)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 39, touch 7, flat-footed 39 (-1 Dex, +32 natural, -2 size)  
 **hp** 460 (23d12+184)  
 **Fort** +22, **Ref** +14, **Will** +18  
 **Defensive Abilities** ray reflection; **DR** 20/magic; **Immune** paralysis, sleep, sonic; **SR** 27  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 60 ft., burrow 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor)  
 **Melee** bite +33 (2d8+16/19-20), 2 claws +32 (2d6+11), tail slap +30 (2d6+16), 2 wings +30 (1d8+5)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (50-ft. cone, 22d4 sonic, DC 28), crush (2d8+16, DC 28)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 23rd; concentration +31)  

  At will—*[color spray](../../magic/spells/color-spray.md)* (DC 19), *[glitterdust](../../magic/spells/glitterdust.md)* (DC 20), *[rainbow pattern](../../magic/spells/rainbow-pattern.md)* (DC 22)  
 3/day—*[prismatic spray](../../magic/spells/prismatic-spray.md)* (DC 25), *[stone to flesh](../../magic/spells/stone-to-flesh.md)* (DC 24)  

 **Sorcerer Spells Known** (CL 11th; concentration +19)  

  5th (5/day)—*[persistent image](../../magic/spells/persistent-image.md)* (DC 23), *[wall of force](../../magic/spells/wall-of-force.md)*  
 4th (8/day)—*[dimension door](../../magic/spells/dimension-door.md)*, *[phantasmal killer](../../magic/spells/phantasmal-killer.md)* (DC 22), *[stone shape](../../magic/spells/stone-shape.md)*  
 3rd (8/day)—*[dispel magic](../../magic/spells/dispel-magic.md)*, *[displacement](../../magic/spells/displacement.md)*, *[lightning bolt](../../magic/spells/lightning-bolt.md)* (DC 21), *[major image](../../magic/spells/major-image.md)* (DC 21)  
 2nd (8/day)—*[blindness/deafness](../../magic/spells/blindness-deafness.md)* (DC 20), *[hypnotic pattern](../../magic/spells/hypnotic-pattern.md)* (DC 20), *[invisibility](../../magic/spells/invisibility.md)*, *[minor image](../../magic/spells/minor-image.md)* (DC 20), *[mirror image](../../magic/spells/mirror-image.md)*  
 1st (8/day)—*[alarm](../../magic/spells/alarm.md)*, *[feather fall](../../magic/spells/feather-fall.md)*, *[magic aura](../../magic/spells/magic-aura.md)*, *[silent image](../../magic/spells/silent-image.md)* (DC 19), *[unseen servant](../../magic/spells/unseen-servant.md)*  
 0 (at will)—*[acid splash](../../magic/spells/acid-splash.md)*, *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[detect poison](../../magic/spells/detect-poison.md)*, *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*, *[open/close](../../magic/spells/open-close.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*, *[touch of fatigue](../../magic/spells/touch-of-fatigue.md)*  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 33, **Dex** 8, **Con** 25, **Int** 20, **Wis** 21, **Cha** 26  
 **Base Atk** +23; **CMB** +36; **CMD** 45 (49 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Deceitful, Great Fortitude, Greater Vital Strike, Hover, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness.*  
 **Skills** Bluff +38, Climb +45, Disguise +35, Fly +17, Intimidate +34, Knowledge (dungeoneering, geography) +31, Perception +31, Sense Motive +31, Stealth +17, Survival +31; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Climb  
 **Languages** Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Terran, Undercommon  
 **SQ** razor sharp  

**Special Abilities**

 **Razor Sharp (Sp)**  All of a crystal dragon’s natural attacks deal slashing damage.  

 **Ray Reflection (Ex)**  An ancient crystal dragon’s scales reflect ray spells back upon the ray’s source if the ray fails to overcome the dragon’s spell resistance.

**Ecology**

**Environment** any underground (Plane of Earth)  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
